title: 第142章 圣人之躯的崩裂之危第141章 女娲圣人请命补天
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
第142章圣人之躯的崩裂之危
所有人的脸上，都露出了茫然和惊恐。
他们不知道发生了什么，但他们能感觉到，一场远比刚才那场大战更加恐怖的大恐怖，正在降临！
昆仑山，玉虚宫。
原本轻松愉悦的气氛，瞬间凝固。
“这是……”
通天教主猛地站了起来，握紧了手中的青萍剑，脸上第一次露出了真正的骇然。
“这股力量……不对劲！这不是鸿钧的天道之力！”
元始天尊的脸色也变得无比凝重，他头顶的庆云剧烈地翻滚着，盘古幡的虚影若隐若现，却在不住地颤抖。
“感觉到了吗？师弟。”
太上老君缓缓睁开眼，他那古井无波的眼神里，此刻也满是惊涛骇浪，“我们体内的盘古元神，在……在哀鸣！”
三清乃盘古元神所化，他们对这股力量的感应，比任何人都要清晰。
那是一种源自血脉最深处的压制！
就像是儿子，见到了父亲。
“是盘古……是盘古大神的本源之力！”
女娲也花容失色，她身后的创生世界树虚影，翠绿的枝叶正在以肉眼可见的速度变得枯黄。
她的造化大道，在这股纯粹的“开辟”之力面前，显得是那样的渺小和脆弱。
四位新晋的人道圣人，在这一刻，都感觉到了死亡的威胁。
那是一种连反抗的念头都难以升起的，绝对的绝望。
就在所有人都被这股突如其来的力量震慑住时，主位之上，顾长青终于有了动作。

他那一直平静无波的眼神，微微眯了起来。
他看着那股正从混沌深处，朝着整个洪荒世界席卷而来的灰色洪流，嘴角勾起了一抹意味深长的弧度。
“原来如此，最后的底牌，就是这个吗？”
他淡淡地开口，声音不大，却清晰地传入了四位圣人的耳中，让他们那几乎要崩溃的心神，瞬间安定了下来。
“盘古开天剩下的边角料而已，也值得你们如此大惊小怪？”
顾长青的话，让四位圣人都愣住了。
边角料？
这足以让圣人都感到绝望的开天本源，在您眼里，就只是……
边角料？
他们还没来得及细想这句话里的深意，那股灰色的开天本源之力，已经彻底地冲破了混沌的束缚，如同决堤的宇宙洪流，向着整个洪荒世界，当头压下！
它的目标，不是某一个人，也不是某一个世界。
而是这方天地间，所有不属于“开天”这个概念本身的一切！
它要将所有后天演化出的“道”，无论是仙道、魔道，还是刚刚兴起的人道，全部抹去！
让世界，重归原点！
灰色的开天本源之力，如同一场无声的宇宙海啸，瞬间淹没了整个洪荒世界。
它没有惊天动地的巨响，也没有毁天灭地的光影。
它只是存在，它的存在本身，就是对其他一切“道”的否定与抹杀。
昆仑山，玉虚宫。
作为新秩序的支柱，人道的四位圣人，在第一时间，就承受了这股力量最核心的冲击。
“噗！”

通天教主首当其冲，他整个人如遭雷击，一口金色的圣人精血狂喷而出。
他感觉自己的“截天剑道”，在这股力量面前，就像是一个笑话。
他引以为傲的，那足以截断万物，斩灭因果的锋锐剑意，在接触到开天本源的瞬间，就被从根源上直接“抹掉”了。
不是被击溃，不是被压制，而是被否定了存在的意义。
content_en:
Chapter 142 The danger of the saint’s body breaking apart
Everyone's faces showed confusion and fear.
They didn't know what was happening, but they could feel that a horror far more terrifying than the previous war was coming!
Kunlun Mountain, Yuxu Palace.
The originally relaxed and joyful atmosphere solidified in an instant.
"This is..."
Leader Tongtian stood up abruptly, clenched the Qingping Sword in his hand, and for the first time his face showed true horror.
"This power... something is wrong! This is not Hongjun's power of heaven!"
Yuanshi Tianzun's face also became extremely solemn, the clouds above his head rolled violently, and the shadow of the Pangu flag was looming, but it was trembling.
"Do you feel it? Junior brother."
Taishang Laojun slowly opened his eyes, and his calm eyes were full of turmoil at this moment, "The Pangu Yuan Shen in our bodies is... whining!"
The Three Pure Ones were transformed by Pangu Yuan Shen, and they sensed this power more clearly than anyone else.
That is a kind of suppression that comes from the deepest part of the bloodline!
It's like a son meeting his father.
"It's Pangu...it's the original power of the Great God Pangu!"
Nuwa's beauty also faded. The Creation World Tree behind her was a shadow, and its green branches and leaves were turning yellow at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Her avenue of creation seemed so small and fragile in front of this pure power of "opening up".
The four newly promoted humanitarian saints all felt the threat of death at this moment.
It was a kind of absolute despair that even the thought of resistance could not arise.
Just when everyone was shocked by this sudden force, Gu Changqing finally made a move in the main position.
His eyes, which had always been calm, narrowed slightly.
He looked at the gray torrent sweeping towards the entire prehistoric world from the depths of chaos, and the corners of his mouth curved in a meaningful arc.
"I see, is this the final trump card?"
He spoke calmly, his voice was not loud, but it reached the ears of the four saints clearly, instantly calming their minds that were about to collapse.
"It's just the leftover scraps from Pangu Kaitian. Is it worth making such a fuss to you?"
Gu Changqing's words stunned the four saints.
Offcuts?
This is enough to make saints feel despair. In your eyes, it is just...
Offcuts?
Before they had time to think about the profound meaning of this sentence, the gray original power of the sky had completely broken through the shackles of chaos, like a cosmic torrent that burst its banks, pressing down on the entire prehistoric world!
Its target is not a certain person or a certain world.
But in this world, everything that does not belong to the concept of "open heaven" itself!
It wants to wipe out all the "Tao" that has evolved in the past, whether it is the immortal way, the demonic way, or the newly emerged human way!
Let the world return to its starting point!
The gray original power of Kaitian was like a silent cosmic tsunami, instantly flooding the entire prehistoric world.
There was no earth-shattering noise, nor was there any light and shadow that destroyed the world.
It just exists, and its existence itself is the denial and obliteration of all other "Taos".
Kunlun Mountain, Yuxu Palace.
As the pillars of the new order, the four saints of humanity immediately withstood the core impact of this force.
"Poof!"
Leader Tongtian was the first to bear the brunt. His whole body felt like being struck by lightning, and a mouthful of golden saint blood spurted out wildly.
He felt that his "Jietian Kendo" was like a joke in front of this power.
The sharp sword intent that he was proud of, which could cut off all things and cut off cause and effect, was directly "erased" from the source the moment it came into contact with the origin of Kaitian.
Not defeated, not suppressed, but denied the meaning of existence.
